message.text: The new revision-read refusal path has no test: all misses CLI fixtures read ordinary text files. The ArrayDeclaration mutant on line 363 replacing the recognized error codes with [] would not fail any of these tests.

explanation.what: The new revision-read refusal path has no test: all misses CLI fixtures read ordinary text files. The ArrayDeclaration mutant on line 363 replacing the recognized error codes with [] would not fail any of these tests.
explanation.whatToDo: Add a mixed export fixture with a replayable miss plus misses on a deleted file, a symlink, and a binary file; assert success, only the replayable case in the output, and diagnostics for the refused cases.
explanation.whyHere: A valid miss on a deleted file, symlink, or binary file must be skipped without preventing other replayable misses from being written. With that mutation the first such file aborts the whole export instead.

properties.failureScenario: A compared range changes src/ok.ts, deletes src/gone.ts, adds src/link.ts as a symlink, and adds src/blob.bin containing NUL. Adjudicate line-1 external reports on each as valid owned-missed and run compare misses --reason owned-missed. Replacing the line-363 error-code array with [] rethrows notFound, symlink, or binary, aborting export instead of writing the src/ok.ts case. The read CLI tests contain none of these inputs, so they do not distinguish this mutation.
